This '''unidentified child''' was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. They were a [[Near-Human]] with fair skin, a flat [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and long blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. Like all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] enslaved individuals of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], they were named after a letter in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and had their letter [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on their face. The Near-Human was brood mates with [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] and [[Yirt (Infinite Empire)|Yirt]], and all five were among those who were used to power the machines of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species that ruled the Infinite Empire. They were present when pack leader Yirt tried to pick on Xesh, who was quickly defended by Trill, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to throw Yirt across the cell. Having been challenged and defeated, Yirt was left at the mercy of the other enslaved individuals, who attacked their former tormentor as Trill and Xesh retreated to another corner of the cell.<ref name="DOTJ 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was first shown in a flashback scene from [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill's]] past in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2]]'', the second issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|The Prisoner of Bogan]]'' story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series.<ref name="DOTJ 7" /> Due to their face only being seen from the side, only half of the [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] character they are named after, is seen; and there are two characters that fit the motif. Their name must be either [[Qek/Legends|Qek]] (which translates as Q) or [[Wesk/Legends|Wesk]] (which translates as W).
